title: get api health returns server and database status
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with a health status indicating both API server and database connectivity are operational.

title: get api companies returns list of companies with frequency counts
description: Verify that GET /api/companies returns HTTP 200 with a list of companies including their frequency counts of questions.

title: get api questions supports filtering and pagination
description: Verify that GET /api/questions supports filtering by company, difficulty, tag, and keyword, and returns paginated results with HTTP 200.

title: get api questions id returns question metadata and company breakdown
description: Verify that GET /api/questions/:id returns HTTP 200 with detailed question metadata and company breakdown for a valid question ID, and returns 404 for invalid IDs.

title: get api questions id solution returns multi approach cpp solutions
description: Verify that GET /api/questions/:id/solution returns HTTP 200 with multi-approach C++ solution details including code, invariants, and complexity for a valid question ID.

title: get api companies overlap returns cross company question intersection
description: Verify that GET /api/companies/overlap returns HTTP 200 with correct cross-company question overlap results for selected companies.

title: post api auth register creates new user with valid data
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register with valid email, username, and password returns HTTP 201 indicating successful account creation, and returns 400 for invalid or missing fields.

title: post api auth login returns access token and refresh cookie
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns HTTP 200 with an access token and sets an HTTP-only refresh cookie, and returns 401 for invalid credentials.

title: get api progress returns user solved map and notes with auth
description: Verify that GET /api/progress with valid authentication token returns HTTP 200 with the user's solved question map and personal notes, and returns 401 without authentication.

title: post api payments create checkout session with valid plan
description: Verify that POST /api/payments/create-checkout-session with a valid planId and authentication returns HTTP 200 with a Stripe checkout session or sandbox redirect URL, and returns error for invalid planId.
